name: DIZZY
tagline: Three legs, one eye, and a spiral it cannot stop looking at.
description: A round, slightly lumpy hand-drawn circle body, outlined in black, uncoloured inside. From the top-left of the body rises one wobbly thin stalk ending in a small round eye outline with a solid black pupil. On the left half of the body sits a red sideways chevron '>' pointing right. On the right edge sits a black spiral of about three turns, overlapping the body outline and bulging past it like a snail shell. Across the lower body, five teal dots in a zigzag row (up, down, up, down, up). Three thin black legs hang below, all different: the left is long and wiggly, the middle is short and straight, the right is longest and angles outward to the right, ending in a foot that kinks sharply back to the left like a hook. Strongly asymmetric.
card: SPECIAL  Spinning spiral makes you dizzy
UP+SPECIAL  Three legs spin like a rotor
GRAB  Hook foot snag, spin and fling
